trust.error: That didn’t go through. Try again.
trust.banner.degraded: Some parts of Rolling are slower than usual.
trust.banner.generation: Generation is temporarily unavailable. Nothing is charged while it’s down.
trust.report.title: Report content
trust.report.sub: Tell us about content made with Rolling that breaks our acceptable use policy. We review every report.
trust.report.emailHint: Only to follow up on this report.
trust.report.childNote: Reports about children are reviewed first. You can also report directly to the police or, in the United States, to the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children at report.cybertip.org.
trust.report.copyright: For copyright, send a <link>DMCA notice</link> instead.
trust.category.sexual_real_person: Sexual content of a real person
trust.appeal.title: Appeal a decision
trust.appeal.subSuspension: Generation and the agent are paused on this account. Tell us why you think this is a mistake.
trust.appeal.subBlock: This run was blocked by our content rules. Tell us why you think this is a mistake.
trust.appeal.nothing: There’s nothing to appeal on this account.
trust.appeal.done: A person will review it and you’ll see the outcome here.
trust.dmca.title: Copyright takedown notice
trust.dmca.sub: Use this form to report content on Rolling that infringes your copyright (Digital Millennium Copyright Act, 17 U.S.C. § 512). Every field is required unless marked optional. False notices can lead to liability.
trust.dmca.field.infringingUrls: Links to the material on Rolling (one per line)
trust.dmca.field.materialDescription: The removed material and where it was
trust.dmca.statement.goodFaith: I have a good-faith belief that the use of the material is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent or the law.
trust.dmca.statement.accuracy: The information in this notice is accurate, and under penalty of perjury, I am the owner or authorized to act on behalf of the owner of the right that is allegedly infringed.
trust.dmca.statement.mistake: Under penalty of perjury, I have a good-faith belief that the material was removed or disabled as a result of mistake or misidentification.
trust.dmca.statement.jurisdiction: I consent to the jurisdiction of the Federal District Court for the judicial district of my address (or, outside the United States, any judicial district in which Rolling may be found).
trust.dmca.statement.service: I will accept service of process from the person who sent the notice, or their agent.
trust.dmca.done: We’ll review it and act on valid notices. Reference: {id}
trust.counter.title: Counter-notice
trust.counter.sub: If content of yours was removed after a copyright notice and you think that was a mistake, send a counter-notice (17 U.S.C. § 512(g)). We forward it to the person who sent the notice.
trust.counter.done: We’ll forward it. The content can come back after 10 business days unless the complainant goes to court. Reference: {id}
